documentation.title: Global Variables Override
documentation.standard:
Variables declared by WordPress in the global namespace should not be overridden by code extending WordPress.
Two WordPress global variables, `$content_width` and `$wp_cockneyreplace`, are specifically intended to be overridden by themes/plugins and are exempt from this rule.

code.title: Valid: Declaring global variables with names not reserved for use by WordPress itself.

code_comparison.code: $prefix_query = new WP_Query( $args ); $GLOBALS['prefix_data'] = 'some data'; foreach ( $selected_posts as $prefix_post ) { // Do something. }

code.title: Invalid: Overriding a WordPress defined global variable.
